To,
The Customer Grievance Redressal Officer,
[Company Name]

Subject: Request for processing of pending refund of Rs. 5,000

Dear Sir/Madam,

I placed an online order bearing Order ID [Order ID] for Rs. 5,000 on [Order Date]. I cancelled the order on [Cancellation Date], and your platform confirmed the cancellation under reference [Reference Number]. However, the refund has not been credited to my original payment method as of [Date].

The payment was made using [Payment Method], with transaction/reference ID [Transaction ID]. I request you to confirm whether the refund has been initiated, provide the refund reference number and expected credit date, and arrange the refund if it has not yet been processed.

Please acknowledge this complaint and provide a written update within a reasonable time.

Regards,
[Your Name]
[Contact Details]
